title: Restricted open direct images belong to the overlap direct-image essential image
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], O,P,W opens with W = O ∩ P, and iO : W → O the inclusion. Fix derived module categories on X,O,P,W in one morphism universe [def-pc-derived-category]. Let S : D(W) → D(O) be any right adjoint of canonical exact derived overlap restriction along iO [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. For every B in D(P), the restriction to O of RjP_* B [def-pc-derived-direct-image] lies in the essential image of S, meaning that there exists M in D(W) and an isomorphism S(M) ≅ (RjP_* B)|O.

proof.text: Put V = P.ι⁻¹(O) in P and g = P.ι restricted to O. The open-image equality P.ι(V) = P ∩ O = W supplies q : V ≅ W by P.ι.isoImage V followed by X.isoOfEq. Its defining identity gives q⁻¹ followed by g equal to k = X.homOfLE(leOfHom iO), by cancellation of the mono O.ι. These are Mathlib image/preimage and open-isomorphism identities.

proof.text: Construct the exact module-sheaf equivalence e from pushforward along q and q⁻¹, using pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr, and pushforwardId for its unit and counit. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies e.functor with restrictFunctor q⁻¹. The restriction composition comparison and q⁻¹ ≫ g = k identify restrictFunctor g followed by e.functor with schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X iO. The latter is exact; reflecting finite limits and colimits through e shows restrictFunctor g is exact. Derive this comparison and e to obtain E : D(V) ≌ D(W) and r_g ⋙ E.functor ≅ overlap restriction. Derive the open adjunction r_g ⊣ Rg_* and compose it with E.toAdjunction; transporting its left adjoint through the comparison gives a right adjoint E.inverse ⋙ Rg_* to overlap restriction. Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq gives its canonical isomorphism j to S.

proof.text: Apply schemeDerivedDirectImage_openRestriction to P.ι and O. It gives bc : RjP_* ⋙ rO ≅ rV ⋙ Rg_*. Put M = rV(B) and choose E.functor(M) as the essential-image preimage. The inverse of j at E.functor(M), then Rg_* of E.unitIso⁻¹ at M, then bc⁻¹ at B is the required isomorphism S(E.functor(M)) ≅ rO(RjP_* B). V uses HasDerivedCategory.standard internally; the restriction theorem and derived equivalence retain its morphism universe separately from the four stated categories. No unproved existence result supplies data.

theorem derived_open_intersection_mem_essImage
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (O P W : X.Opens) (hW : W = O ⊓ P) (iO : W ⟶ O)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings O.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings P.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (S : schemeDerivedCategory W.toScheme ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory O.toScheme)
    (adj : (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X iO).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ S)
    (B : schemeDerivedCategory P.toScheme) :
    S.essImage ((schemeOpenRestriction X O).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage P.ι).obj B))
